name: BAR-FLY
author: keste
description: Eight original 16-step bossa nova grooves (soft kick, cross-stick rim, closed hat) launch from pads 9-16, with 56 percent swing, plus/minus 8 ms humanize, per-voice velocities and an optional 8-bar song form. All 24 BAR-FLY voices use the real Nuked OPL3 (YMF262 v1.8) core. The isolation-test preset is gone; 20 factory presets remain. Retained WOPL additions are Percussive Organ (preset 18) and FM5 Grand Piano (preset 19). Presets 4-6 have distinct electric-piano recipes; SOUL / MOTOWN keeps the phaser and adds a gentle auto-wah; JAZZ ROOM is the only vibraphone. DMXOPL 60's Organ 1 remains preset 17, and STAGE PIANO replaces GRAND PIANO. The colour rack adds flanger, auto-wah, ring modulation and bitcrusher with subtle use on MK II RHODES, OPL3 E.PIANO, SOUL / MOTOWN and ACE TONE. The Leslie is a clean-room dual-rotor model with independent horn/drum motors, geometric Doppler and a stereo mic mix; it is off by default in every factory preset and F6 toggles it.
